Which statement about an atom of fluorine,
, is correct?
A
It contains a total of 28 protons, neutrons and electrons.
B
It contains more protons than neutrons.
C
Its isotopes contain different numbers of protons.
D
Its nucleus contains 9 neutrons.

options.label: A
options.text: It contains a total of 28 protons, neutrons and electrons.

options.label: B
options.text: It contains more protons than neutrons.

options.label: C
options.text: Its isotopes contain different numbers of protons.
